title: GaborNet: Gabor filters with learnable parameters in deep convolutional neural networks
mechanism: First-layer convolution filters constrained to Gabor functions whose parameters are learned by backpropagation.
adaptation: A parallel stem of 16 learnable Gabor filters (8 orientations x 2 scales, wavelength 4 to 8 px) on the 1-channel EL input, concatenated to the conv1 output.
min_experiment: Arm: house + Gabor stem, 5 seeds. Baseline: house. Metric: crack IoU, relF1@2. Kill: crack IoU < +0.012.
evidence: R: faster convergence and better accuracy than plain CNNs on several recognition datasets (abstract).
